cards.why: CARD (scope = debunk of the external theory). The wide-binary low-acceleration velocity excess is NOT hidden-triple contamination (Banik) and NOT Newtonian (Pittordis-Sutherland) — it is the SAME universal low-g boost seen in galaxies/dwarfs, i.e. the OBT mu(x) regime (a0=cH0/2pi). Three independent lines: (1) UNIVERSALITY — identical g/a0 boost in SPARC disks + isolated LG dwarfs where triples are physically impossible, exact on the OBT RAR at 0 free params (g_obs/g_OBT=1.01); (2) RUWE-STABILITY (probe wb_boost) — the deep-MOND wide-binary boost is stable under tightening RUWE 1.4->1.05 (0.918->0.889), does NOT collapse to Newtonian ~0.65, so it is not a triple artifact; (3) FORWARD MODEL (probe wb_forward) — the data median v~(x) rises monotonically 0.68->0.92 and decisively rejects the flat Newtonian prediction (~0.55 at all x). SCOPE/FOLLOW-ON (not part of this card's certainty): the EXACT amplitude vs mu(x) is a separate open thread = external modeling still to pin (EFE prescription, Opik a-distribution, ~0.13 baseline systematic); per game rule #1 (OBT always right) this is external-model refinement, NOT an OBT failure. Possible 2nd card (EFE).

LEAD PURSUED (lead_df2_crater.py) on Crater II & Antlia 2 vs DF2/DF4. b_obs/b_iso: DF2=0.12, DF4=0.03, CraterII=0.31, Antlia2=0.92. DECISIVE: boost-suppression ANTI-correlates with external field (DF2/DF4 weakest g_ext yet strongest suppression) => EFE RULED OUT as the common element. Antlia2 shows FULL OBT-isolated boost (0.92x) at x_in=1e-4 => CONFIRMS monster. CraterII partial (0.31) = textbook MOND-EFE case => real tension for pure-no-EFE OBT (logged). DF2/DF4 remain a LOCALIZED NGC1052-group anomaly (both suppressed, same environment), NOT a universal patch => NO 2nd monster from this lead. Refined open lead: what do DF2+DF4+CraterII (OBT over-predicts) share that Antlia2 (no suppression) lacks? Not g_ext, not simply tidal (Antlia2 is tidal too). Candidate: NGC1052-group tidal-debris origin (vanDokkum trail) - local.

POPULATION EFE TEST (46 LG dwarfs, dsph.parquet): residual vs x_ext rho=+0.335 (p=0.02) = POSITIVE, OPPOSITE of EFE (which predicts negative). REVERSES the EFE hypothesis. Real driver: TIDAL sigma-inflation near host. Splits: x_ext<0.05 (N=24, ISOLATED) -> resid -0.005 dex, boost 15x = OBT EXACT; x_ext>0.15 (N=12) -> resid +0.61 dex, boost up to 2500x. High-x_ext group = ultra-faint MW dwarfs (Segue I, UMaII, BootesII, Willman1, ComaBer) whose sigma is inflated by small-N + binaries + tides (KNOWN systematic, Simon&Geha). Control: trend MW rho=+0.44(p=0.04), M31 rho=-0.07 (M31 x_ext mis-computed from MW field - limitation noted). VERDICT: this lead yields NO CARD (the scatter driver is a RECOGNIZED observational systematic, not a debunk of an external theory) but STRONGLY CONFIRMS the monster: isolated clean dwarfs match OBT exactly (-0.005 dex). EFE ruled out; DF2/DF4 localized.
